semantic_atoms.finding: The dedicated gespraech_erinnerung table stores id, ts, subject, value and quelle. The inspected schema has no explicit transformation class, epistemic class, source-event/admission identity, privacy-retention class or content digest field.
semantic_atoms.boundary: The table is deliberately narrow and separate from durable_memory. This finding does not imply arbitrary UnifiedDB write authority and does not prove other retrieval consumers lack later typing.

semantic_atoms.finding: gespraech_erinnerung_lesen returns conversation-memory rows as {ts,subject,value,quelle}; for non-empty queries it appends durable_memory rows to the same treffer list using the same structural shape, with quelle='durable_memory' as the principal visible discriminator. No explicit VERBATIM/SUMMARY/INFERENCE/OBSERVED/VERIFIED class is returned on this direct path.
semantic_atoms.boundary: Separate storage tables remain intact; the collapse occurs at the direct Realtime retrieval projection. A source label is useful provenance but is not equivalent to epistemic status or transformation provenance.

semantic_atoms.finding: _tool_erinnerung_lesen forwards directly to stern gespraech-erinnerung-lesen and _tool_erinnerung_schreiben validates only non-empty subject/value before forwarding to stern with quelle=realtime-tool. The wrapper adds no deterministic MemoryAdmission or epistemic typing.
semantic_atoms.boundary: This is a direct source property of the inspected Realtime tool bridge, not runtime proof of model behavior or a repository-wide claim about every memory consumer.

contradiction_update.TW5-CONTRADICTION-REALTIME-MEMORY-AUTHOR: NARROWED_SOURCE_CONFIRMED: storage separation exists, but direct Realtime read/write projection lacks explicit epistemic/transformation/admission typing

counterhypotheses.claim: Other non-Realtime memory consumers may add stronger epistemic typing before decision use.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Audit every consumer of gespraech_erinnerung and durable_memory that can influence decisions; preserve any stronger downstream typing rather than generalizing this direct-reader result repository-wide.

counterhypotheses.claim: Prompt prose may instruct the Realtime model to treat retrieved memories cautiously.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Typed retrieval metadata and deterministic admission remain required for authority semantics because prompt compliance cannot create factual provenance.

frankenstein_2_design_delta.MemoryAdmission: Deterministic admission decides whether and how a MemoryCandidate is persisted. Realtime model Function Calling proposes a candidate; it does not mint factual truth.
frankenstein_2_design_delta.MemoryRecord: Persist admitted provenance and epistemic/transformation class. Storage authority remains one canonical substrate; no second truth store is introduced.
frankenstein_2_design_delta.RetrievalProjection: When conversation-memory and durable-memory items are returned together, every item retains source, transformation, epistemic, admission and generation/provenance metadata. Ranking or formatting must not erase these classes.
frankenstein_2_design_delta.PromotionLaw: Remembering that actor A said X is evidence of the utterance/claim, not evidence that X is true. Canonical factual promotion requires independent admissible evidence.
